Senses.Explanation: Li Zunxu is the Song prince-consort and lay participant whom lamp records preserve questioning masters, composing a realization verse, and testing visiting monastics. Zen records deploy him through his exchanges and later masters’ appraisals, not merely through his court office or appearance in catalogues.
